name: Echoes from the Void
preview: A ragged band of mercenaries, drawn together by a mysterious summons, arrived in Brightend just as the King's peace began to fracture...
story:
Summoned to the Alabaster Palace by Lord White, a ragged band of mercenaries took on what seemed to be a simple retrieval job: find a missing Runebridge scholar named Maera Voss, and secure the ancient text she was hired to translate.

Their investigation through the streets of Brightend led them to a disappearing door hidden in a wealthy alleyway. Stepping through the anomaly, the party was pulled into the Vale House—an impossible, time-displaced mansion suspended in a permanent pocket dimension. Battling animated armor, mimics, and the fiendish illusions of the mansion's defenses, they unearthed the disturbing, ancient laboratories of its long-gone masters and successfully rescued the captive scholar from a chained room.

But their salvation brought a terrifying revelation. Maera's research proved that the established history of the ancient Doleris civilization was a lie, and the timeline of the world itself had been altered. Worse still, upon escaping back to the material plane, they found her office ransacked. The highly coveted **Ninefold Commentary** had been stolen by three hooded figures.

> "Only the King and I seem to think something is happening... there is no guild, but one group has become much more present."

Now, the party must hide Maera from those who want her silenced. Forging a tense alliance with the Grand Warden, they have been tasked to hunt down an invisible, highly-organized syndicate responsible for a string of perfect crimes—before the stolen secrets of the void can be unleashed upon Eperina.

quests.title: Exfiltration
quests.description: Help Maera escape Brightend and offer her self passage to the Athenaeum.

quests.title: A String of Thefts
quests.description:
Brightened has been plagued by a string of mysterious thefts, according to The Wardens.
All seem to be connect to a mysterious group - the Talons, operating from their secret Roost.

name: The Last Sigil
preview: Two scholars are sent to survey an ancient site recently unearthed. Thought to be an ancient Doleris temple, the site is a labyrinth of strange arcane phenomena that forces the adventurers to confront their own memories
story:
Asked to investigate old ruins in the Wolf's Cradle, Eli and Maevik are taken through the Wildlands by a group of mercenaries. Upon arrival they discover a strange underground temple in far worse shape than expected.

Their investigation quickly led them to realize that itself wasn't flowing properly there. After being stuck in a sort of time loop, plagued by strange dreams, the brave scholars discover what looks like a small study in a demi-plane. There they find copious work written by Doleris Scholars and a strange artifact : The Last Sigil.

Taking their discovery back to the Athenaeum, they are sent to Runebridge, in search of an eminent scholar who might be able to help them decypher it all... only to find him missing. With the Dean of Runebridge particularly suspect, they decide to flee and keep on investigating, on their own.

Their adventures took the heroes to the confines of the Dreamlands, where they obtained a powerful magic ingredient  - a crystallized memory -  that they will hopefully combine with nihilium, in a ritual ti restore the Sigil. The final ingredient, the actual know-how that they need to perform the ritual is apparently held by a missing scholar, Sam Eredil. 

On their way to Sam, the heroes discovered, in the middle of the inhabited wildlands, that a settlement exists. From there, they will attempt to find Sam, before time runs out.

quests.title: Perform the Ritual
quests.description: Stabilize the Last Sigil before it collapses upon itself.

quests.title: Finding Sam
quests.description: Sam Eredil, a briliant researcher in mathemagics has gone missing. Thanks to some helpful students, it might possible to find him.
